why: I checked every named file and claim against the repository, and they all hold. bin/greet.js uses the first argument that doesn't start with "--" as the name and ignores flags, so "`node bin/greet.js --shout Ann` prints `Hello, Ann!` and exits 0" is accurate. A missing name prints a usage message to stderr and exits 2, as the issue says. docs/index.md shows only `node bin/greet.js <name>`. .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads docs/ on every push to main. The site URL comes from README.md. test/greet.test.js and src/greet.js exist, and `npm test` is defined in package.json. The issue says "greet --shout <name>" in places, but package.json has no bin entry. That shorthand matches the CLI's own usage text, and every expect line uses the real path, bin/greet.js. Nothing the issue names is missing, and the problem statement describes the code as it is.
